subject: Shiny App Calling External Windows Application

messages.author: 1372f6bdb9dc302f
messages.subject: Shiny App Calling External Windows Application
parts:
I've written an app that calls an external Windows-only application using the system() function, and it works fine locally.  I'd like this app to be accessible online, and I'm aware that hosting Shiny apps is restricted to some operating systems like Ubuntu.  Is it possible/has anyone succeeded in hosting a Shiny app that calls an external Windows application?

My experience outside of Windows is non-existent, so I may be a little slow on the uptake.  Apologies in advance!

Howard

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Shiny App Calling External Windows Application
parts:
shinyapps.io indeed runs on Ubuntu.
You would need to make your Windows application available to be called over the Internet, as it cannot be hosted itself on shinyapps.io
